SECRET

P.F. 66074/F.3.M.  21st June, 1945.

Dear Governor,

Thank you very much for letting me see the enclosed letter, which I now return. As far as we are concerned it can be given to the prisoner.

Yours sincerely,

G.R. Mitchell.

To Governor,
Brixton Prison,
BRIXTON.

MRS/PMH
